_comment_enzyme_upper_bound: Enzyme pool (g enzyme/gDW) = Ptot * f * sigma = 0.09
_comment_gam_reaction: Reaction carrying the GAM ATP cost. In rhto/yeast-GEM this is the biomass pseudoreaction r_4041, not the growth objective r_2111.
_comment_kcat_value: Initial kcat column: kcat_mean | kcat_min | kcat_max (CPI-Pred fold stats).
_comment_maintenance: Apply experimental NGAM/GAM before enzyme-constrained FBA. Sweep is post-hoc sensitivity only.

fva._comment_opt_ratio: Fraction of optimal biomass to constrain during FVA (0.9 = 90% of optimal)
fva._comment_workers: Set to null for auto-detection (uses all CPU cores)
fva._comment_chunk_size: Number of reactions per task. null = auto-calculate. Larger = less overhead but less load balanc`ing

_comment_medium: Signed [lb, ub]: negative=uptake, positive=secretion. r_1634=FIX acetate uptake at the measured rate. r_1714/r_1718/r_1808=block glucose, xylose, glycerol — omitting r_1714 leaves the default lb=-1, which becomes r_1714_reverse ub=1 after the irreversible split (glucose leak). r_1992=O2 cap; r_1672=CO2 secretion; r_1687=citrate secretion; r_2091=block urea; r_1654=ammonium.

biomass_composition._comment: Rekena (2023) experimental biomass composition on acetate exponential growth

simulated_annealing._comment_aggressive: AGGRESSIVE SETTINGS - larger perturbations and longer search
simulated_annealing._comment_temperature: High starting temp (100) for large initial exploration
simulated_annealing._comment_biomass_goal: Target experimental growth rate from Crown et al. (2015) - 0.75 1/hr for E. coli on glucose M9
simulated_annealing._comment_n_top_enzymes: Tune top 500 enzymes for sufficient optimization flexibility

maintenance_sweep._comment_ngam_range: NGAM values to test (ATPM lower bound in mmol/gDW/h). Range to find optimal match to experimental 0.75 growth rate
maintenance_sweep._comment_gam_range: GAM values to test (ATP in biomass, mmol/gDW). 75.55 is the original iML1515 value
